title: Savills Commercial Property Scraper
description: Extract commercial properties for sale from Savills. Use filters or provide a custom Savills search URL.

start_url.title: Start URL (Optional)
start_url.description: Custom Savills search URL. If provided, filter options below are ignored. Navigate to Savills, apply your filters, and paste the URL here.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location to search (e.g., 'europe', 'london', 'france', 'germany'). Used only if Start URL is empty.

property_type.title: Property Type
property_type.description: Type of commercial property to search.

min_price.title: Minimum Price
min_price.description: Minimum property price (in default currency, e.g., 1000000 for 1M).

max_price.title: Maximum Price
max_price.description: Maximum property price (in default currency, e.g., 5000000 for 5M).

results_wanted.title: Maximum Results
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of properties to extract.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy for reliable scraping.
